name: Easy Sheet Pan Shrimp, Gnocchi & Zucchini Bake with Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash, dry, and trim zucchini. Halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a large bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; large dice. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.

Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, along with gnocchi, pesto, and oil, then stir to combine. Divide between the baking sheets and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve the bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium red onion
2 (454 g) pkg potato gnocchi
sun-dried tomato pesto
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until veggies are tender, about 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Transfer to the reserved bowl, along with additional pesto and crushed red pepper, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
3 tbsp sun-dried tomato pesto
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are tender, remove baking sheets from the oven, stir, and spread back out into an even layer. Scatter shrimp over top, then return baking sheets to the oven. Continue to bake until the shrimp are cooked through, 5-7 minutes more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide shrimp, gnocchi, and veggies between plates. Sprinkle with Parmesan and enjoy!
